findings.evidence: The roadmap explicitly specifies `pinToOrthogonal Q : pinGroup Q →* orthogonalGroup Q` at README.md:336 and Suggested.lean:112; Mathlib provides `pinGroup.involute_act_ι_mem_range_ι` at SpinGroup.lean:188, while `spinGroup` is defined as `pinGroup Q ⊓ even Q` at SpinGroup.lean:293.
findings.fix: Define `pinAction`/`pinToOrthogonal : pinGroup Q →* QuadraticMap.orthogonalGroup Q` using `involute x * ι Q m * x⁻¹`, then derive the spin action and homomorphism by restricting along `spinGroup ≤ pinGroup`.
findings.issue: `spinActionLinear`, `spinAction`, and `spinToOrthogonal` develop only the spin special case instead of the general pin-group twisted action.

summary: The construction is restricted to the spin group, while the natural and roadmap-specified action is the twisted-conjugation homomorphism for the pin group, with the spin map derived by restriction.
